objective: Improve five-class participant accuracy without concealing minority-class failures
selection: Inner pooled out-of-fold accuracy; macro-F1 breaks accuracy ties, then smaller C
scaling: StandardScaler fitted separately inside each fitting fold
comparison: Identical participant folds and four regularization candidates per model/input; training-fold majority baseline required
evaluation_participants: 163 official training participants only; all 275 participants and all 281 physical sources remain accounted for upstream
output_contract: Class predictions and explicitly named decision scores; SVM scores must not be presented as calibrated probabilities
limitations: Post-final exploratory model development. Accuracy-first selection differs from earlier macro-F1-first tuning, so logistic controls must be refitted with the same new selection rule. No independent generalization claim.
